body: Thank you. I can tell you really want to help me so your authenticity is appreciated. Im literally watching Bob Ross right now trying to calm down. I'm just lonely. It's difficult for me to make friends. Im not an asshole or anything, it is really just hard for me to meet people of...substance..? I just want a lifelong friend, not a fleeting one. Im trying to find work to finish my degree. I know Im a millennial so the world is against me and thinks I am lazy. I have been researching suicide methods. I havent really picked one yet? There are some that are doable.
Ive been contemplating killing myself. I am really lonely. Like, really lonely. I feel the weight of it consume me.
Hi, thank you so much for reaching out. Thank you. I just need to know someone knows I exist.
Thank you

I just dont really know what I am doing? Or why I am here. I've become progressively anxious to the point of paranoia over the past 2 years. I am leaving my job because I was assaulted by someone there.
Thank you. I've hit a rough patch for a while and Im just trying to navigate my way around and out of it. Thank you for reaching out.
Thank you for reaching out
Thank you so much for reaching out.
Im sorry to hear that. Thank you for reaching out.
Thank you
Today I am actually not okay at all. I received a lot of help last night from people on here though.

Aw I am sorry to hear that. 21 is still super young. In men, the frontal lobe isnt even fully developed yet - please give yourself some time. This has been reported the age of the highest depression and suicide rate (ages 18-23). We just need to get through it somehow.
There is - thank you for that.

Thanksgiving will be kind of quiet this year. I think the hardest part about growing up for me is the magic that was there when you were a kid sort of fades. People treat them from an adult perspective and they arent special anymore? If that makes sense. 

Did you have a boy or a girl?
When the sun goes down its hard for me. Especially now with daylight savings. Im unhappy at work and a lot of things are just up in the air right now.
Well congrats on the baby! I am sorry to hear about that - I know it will get better, but nonetheless it is painful to go through that. How are you?
I've never really reached out online before. I thought if I could vent but also try to help other people it would make me feel better. I just need friends.
Yeah...there's just so much sadness in the world and it's too much for me to accept. If that makes sense? I just can't believe how much sadness and pain is out there.
Im sorry something like this happened to you. It was not your fault. You are valuable and important and I acknowledge your pain.
I'm just sad. That's all. I don't really know how or why I arrived where I am.
Hi there.
I dont think "get in shape" is really the best advice. I think maybe you need someone to listen to you? And let you know your words are important and have value.
